component.name: WoA RK3576 Imager
component.summary: Install Windows on RK3576 boards over USB and write their UEFI firmware

description.p: WoA RK3576 Imager installs Windows 11 23H2 on the eMMC of Rockchip RK3576 boards (LCKFB TaishanPi 3M, ArmSoM CM5-IO) from a computer over USB, without a USB stick: it writes the woa-rk3576 WinPE and your Windows image to the eMMC in Maskrom mode, and the board installs Windows from there by itself.
It also writes the edk2-rk3576 UEFI firmware, over Maskrom or, when it runs on the board itself under Linux, directly.
First version, forked from Roxora Imager 0.1.10: Windows on the eMMC without a USB stick, firmware writes, and writing the board it runs on.
